title: brewrig config
description: Configuration for brewrig (~/.brewrig/config.json): the private sync remote, this machine's name, and how sync and update behave.

remote.description: The private git remote holding machines/*.json. brewrig verifies it is private and refuses a public one.

machine.description: This machine's name: the stem of the file it publishes, and the name other machines see in a prompt. Stored rather than derived each run, so renaming the Mac does not orphan its inventory.

branch.description: Branch published to. Defaults to main.

greedyCasks.description: Let `update` also upgrade casks that auto-update themselves. Off by default: upgrading one can restart a running app.

autoApply.description: Let `sync` install what is missing in the same run. Removals are never automatic regardless of this.
